title: Quran recitation audio (every ayah)
need: Written commercial licence from a reciter/producer (streaming + caching, with credit), or commission a qari and own the recordings. Option: Quran Foundation API (check commercial terms).
state: Hidden. Turn on with env LICENSED_RECITATION=1 after licence.

title: Makkah (Masjid al-Haram) adhan
need: Permission from the General Authority for the Affairs of the Two Holy Mosques or the recording owner. Makkah uploads found online were copied from YouTube.
state: Not included. Never label another recording “Makkah”.

title: Famous nasheeds (Soldiers of Allah, al-Muqit, Sami Yusuf, Maher Zain, Omar Esa, Bukhatir…)
need: Licence from each artist or label.

title: Other Quran translations (Sahih International, Khattab, Hilali-Khan, Asad, Urdu, Tamil, Sinhala…)
need: Publisher permission per translation. ClearQuran is free for commercial use with credit and unchanged wording.

title: Map tiles at very large scale
need: OpenFreeMap is free with no SLA. At scale: self-host tiles (set MAP_STYLE_URL) or a paid provider (MapTiler / Stadia).

title: Google Maps inside the app (optional)
need: Google Maps Platform billing + terms; no copying Google places data into our database.
state: Only free “Open in Google Maps” / directions links.

title: “Shukr” name & logo
need: Trademark search and registration in key markets.

title: Copyright complaints for user uploads
need: Register a DMCA agent (US Copyright Office) and publish a takedown policy.
state: Upload rights confirmation exists; agent not registered.

title: Privacy policy, Terms, children’s privacy, PayHere agreement
need: Lawyer review before launch.

title: Quran Arabic text (Tanzil)
need: CC BY 3.0 — credit + link tanzil.net; text verbatim.

title: Pickthall English (1930)
need: Public domain — credit translator.

title: Hadith Arabic texts
need: Public domain / Unlicense.

title: Shukr’s own English (hadith, duas, adhkar, akhirah)
need: Ours. Recommend scholar review for accuracy.

title: 20 adhan recordings
need: CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA — keep credits page; trimmed CC BY-SA files stay CC BY-SA.

title: 61 library sounds (nasheeds, vocals, nature)
need: Same as adhans. Human listen for instruments on the 20 newest nasheeds.

title: OpenStreetMap data
need: ODbL — attribution must stay visible on the map.

title: MapLibre, Leaflet, adhan-js, fonts (Amiri, Figtree), Twemoji
need: Keep licence files and credits.

title: Users’ uploads & studio nasheeds
need: Users confirm rights on upload; respond to takedowns.

title: AI features (Alim, voices, captions)
need: Check AI providers’ commercial terms; disclose AI voices.

title: Videos & images in the main feed
need: Confirm each is Shukr-made or licensed.
